title: Fresh American Sardines Stew
description: Sour and pillowy American dish that's light on the palate, featuring sardines in a flavorful cataplana stew. This low-sodium recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic and parsley until well combined.
In a large cataplana vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the onion to the vessel and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and parsley mixture to the vessel and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sardines, tomato paste, lemon juice, white wine vinegar, bay leaves, and chicken broth to the vessel.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season the stew with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
